_comment: v4rian pool/* creation restriction. Pins pool/* ref creation to the allocator flow; developers never create pool refs. The pool/*.reconcile.* name shape is carved OUT of the lock so the CI claim publishes rebase candidates with its plain workflow token - candidates are frozen receipts the provenance audit flags when an unexpected actor creates one. Deletion lives in the separate pool-deletions ruleset. Bypass actors: repository admins only. Apply via .io.v4rian.neo-git/scripts/apply-repo-rules.sh.
name: v4rian-pool-creations
